provenance.origin: SYNTHETIC, hand-authored kill-probe fixture — NOT HN data, NOT flagged/removed-post data
provenance.purpose: Capability probe for kill phrases. The real 40-post Show-HN sample (show_hn_sample.json) has 0 kill firings — honestly reported as 'untested-not-proven', since a sample of legitimate posts cannot prove the kill mechanism works. This fixture asks the narrower question: CAN any persona's kill phrase fire at all, does each designed-bad post get killed, and do the personas spare a well-evidenced post and a paraphrase?
provenance.honest_limit: Synthetic posts embed the kill phrases verbatim, so this probes mechanism liveness, not detection subtlety. A paraphrase post (edge-01) is included and must NOT be killed — the mechanism is literal today; that is a pinned finding, not a silent gap. Replace with a real flagged/removed Show-HN sample when one is obtainable, then re-pin.
provenance.license_note: Written for this repo; no external text copied.
